compress_messages: compress a list of conversation messages by replacing low-relevance content with stubs when token count exceeds a trigger threshold
extract_last_user_message: extract the text content from the last user message in a conversation list
get_protected_indices: get indices of messages that must never be compressed including system, last user, and last assistant messages
combine_scores: combine BM25 and embedding scores with weighted average and min-max normalization for message relevance ranking
build_retrieval_tool: build a retrieval tool definition from a list of cache keys for recovering stubbed message content
